# Causal Integrity

> Machine-oriented AI alignment hypothesis: coherent causality preferred by action; formal instruments (causal ledger, UPB-style universality, coherence preference) for base-level safety rails. FOL + Lean skeleton.

Canonical: https://github.com/NetworkYum/causal-integrity

- [Definition of done](docs/definition-of-done.md): S0–S4 completeness ladder
